reviewMethod: Codex drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Summons service and court-date timing
headings.reviewNote: Read four-day service and twenty-one-business-day court date, subject to written consent to later date.

headings.title: Requested posting and mailing with limits on default judgments
headings.reviewNote: Includes attempted personal service, both ten-day steps, return/affidavit proof and no money judgment on posting-based default.

headings.title: Alias summons and service by posting and mailing
headings.reviewNote: Includes adult plaintiff/agent option, affidavit proof and repeated default-money-judgment limit; no universal personal-service equivalence claimed.

headings.title: Postjudgment motions, final possession, and default notice
headings.reviewNote: Read ten-day relief routes and finality/eviction notice; topic does not resolve interaction with other appeal statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all four subsections and legislative history. Four-day service, twenty-one-business-day court date, and ten-day posting/mailing are distinct. Posting remains additional to attempted personal service, default money judgments are restricted, and subsection 4 concerns postjudgment timing rather than an unconditional eviction entitlement.

headings.title: Hearing, judgment, and execution for rent and possession
headings.reviewNote: Read rent demand/nonpayment/tender, posting-default exception, five-day possession delivery and possession-only election.

headings.title: Qualified liability protection for removing tenant property
headings.reviewNote: Limited to court-ordered execution and preserves willful/wanton/malicious exception.

headings.title: Notice and recovery of marked third-party property
headings.reviewNote: Read post-execution conspicuous permanent marking, certified notice, five-business-day recovery and inability-to-notify disposal.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all three subsections and Rice annotation. Possession-only election, tender, and default/posting money-judgment restriction retained. Removal immunity excludes willful, wanton, or malicious conduct, and marked third-party property requires separate notice and recovery opportunity. Historical jury-review annotation not expanded into present procedural advice.

headings.title: Written disclosure of management and service contacts
headings.reviewNote: Includes owner/authorized agent and special post-office-box mailing provisions.

headings.title: Keeping information current and successor obligations
Agency consequences of failing to disclose
headings.reviewNote: Read service/notice and performance/rent obligations; unusual expending wording retained without repair.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read the complete body and history. Disclosure includes both names and addresses, post-office-box service details, current information, and successor obligations. Noncompliance agency consequences retain both service and landlord-duty branches; awkward final collection wording preserved without repair.

headings.title: Establishing the court and appointing commissioners
headings.reviewNote: City ordinance/funding and judges discretionary establishment; two-commissioner maximum and mixed judicial/mayoral appointment body.

headings.title: Commissioners’ authority and limits
headings.reviewNote: Read money/possession/equity authority and no ex-parte cases/orders.

headings.title: Commissioner qualifications, compensation, and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: City residency, licensure, one-third judge compensation, conflicts and excluded state employment/retirement benefits retained.

headings.title: Court procedures and staffing
headings.reviewNote: Nonjury hearing, affirmative merits/defenses inquiry, questioning and clerical/computer staffing.

headings.title: Requesting an associate circuit court hearing
headings.reviewNote: Ten days after mailing or service; source does not specify object of mailing/service, not invented.

headings.title: Recording proceedings and seeking review
headings.reviewNote: City-funded electronic recording, de-novo or appellate routes with exact source cross-references.

headings.title: Summons return dates and service attempts
headings.reviewNote: Ten-day return and sheriff attempt within four days, no guarantee of completed service.

headings.title: City funding to establish and operate the court
headings.reviewNote: StLouisCity cost obligation distinct from JacksonCounty535.210pilot.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all eight subsections and history. Establishment depends on city ordinance and judicial action; commissioner powers exclude ex parte proceedings. Subsection 5 source omits the object of mailing/service, so title does not invent it. Four days concerns attempted summons service, not guaranteed completion; city funding and review routes are accurately distinguished.
